description: iTunes MP3 encoder iTunes 12.13.12.3, converted through iTunes' ConvertFile2: 128 kbit/s, variable bitrate on, quality 7 (Highest), joint stereo, sample rate and channels automatic, on the synthetic source music-44k-stereo.wav.

encoder.settings: 128 kbit/s, variable bitrate on, quality 7 (Highest), joint stereo, sample rate and channels automatic

input.name: music-44k-stereo.wav
input.generator: sources/make_sources.py of the sample kit (written from nothing, reproducible byte for byte)

selected_for: iTunes' Xing header; its table of contents is not increasing
note: The encoder stamps the time of the encode into the file; the file is committed as written, and checked by its content.
